failureHistory.observedFailure: The reading pane must scroll its text: before and after y were both -166.33333333333337.

failureHistory.name: compact-result-replay

failureHistory.diagnosis: Restored scenery clearance, heading, 110pt decorative cast and result prose preceded four action rows and placed Replay below the SE viewport.
failureHistory.correction: Try the full scenic terminal layout, then a compact bottom-aligned layout without decorative cast/clearance/heading inset, then scroll if the compact content still cannot fit. Preserve all labels, identifiers, actions and full targets.

failureHistory.name: hosted-award-obsolete-crop

failureHistory.correction: Resolve actual StarlightAnchors board/header in window coordinates, require nonempty/in-bounds/stable region, retain >100 additional bright pixels and exact score/category/lifetime assertions. No app testability seam was added.

failureHistory.name: rendered-run-preference-selector

failureHistory.correction: Constrain the Studio preview using its actual viewport and the shared bounded reader; scroll authoring controls separately from the paragraph, preserving complete text and fixed Next/Close controls.
failureHistory.rerunStatus: Full largest-text method and bundled all-speaker script method passed.

failureHistory.name: normal-motion-menu-pause-transition
failureHistory.observedFailure: XCTAssertTrue failed in assertPausedAfterMenuDismisses at line 26. Log shows the menu pause action followed by repeated experiment.done existence checks.
failureHistory.diagnosis: The full-screen cover detaches the scene, so the sceneReady guard rejected the explicit menu Pause action.
failureHistory.correction: Permit the menu choice, immediately suspend again, and let the existing scene-readiness admission resume clocks only after the scene is ready.
failureHistory.rerunStatus: Both the original normal-motion forecast method and active-message reopening method passed, including exact Pause/Resume labels, full targets, dismissal, a new automatic shower and pause again.

failureHistory.name: largest-text-script-action-wrapping

failureHistory.correction: Shared script controls use a horizontal row only when full natural label widths fit, otherwise full-width vertical actions. The new native assertion requires single-line-height, full-width stacked controls.
failureHistory.rerunStatus: Both largest-text game/Studio and all-speaker methods passed on dev.22a4a0f991. Independent beginning/end screenshots confirm final text and fixed single-line full-width vertical actions; normal-text horizontal controls also inspected.
